model: Supra Universal SPR-UB 8-relay lighting controller (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Touch-Plate Supra Universal SPR-UB relay controller (firing card) for 8 lighting relays.
summary: The SPR-UB is the controller card in a Touch-Plate Supra lighting relay panel. Each card is its own BACnet MS/TP device with 8 Binary Outputs, one per relay (relay 1 is listed; BO 2-8 follow the same pattern), plus an override status value. Relays can be switched by hand at the panel, which sets the BO's Override flag.
notes: The relays are printed as one range, BO 1-8, with the name pattern "Relay 00#" (# = relay 1-8). Only relay 1 is listed; add the relay number for the others.
The AV 1003 property table prints Object_Name "Device Options", which looks like a copy error; the object table calls it Device Instance.
There is no read/write column; access is inferred. BOs have a priority array.
The panel's own inputs drive the relays at priority 16, fixed.

integration.summary: Command each relay through its BO. Write at priority 16 if local switches should still work; a higher priority locks out the switches until the BMS relinquishes. Watch AV 1002 and the BO Override flags for manual overrides at the panel.

minimum_points.name: Relay 001
minimum_points.why: Relay 1 on/off; BO 2-8 for the other relays

minimum_points.name: Relay Override
minimum_points.why: Last relay overridden by hand, 0 = none

integration.enable: Relays are commanded directly through BO 1-8. Commands above priority 16 make the panel ignore its switch inputs for that relay until relinquished.
setup: MS/TP MAC address by DIP switches; baud 9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800 by option DIP switches (power cycle after a change).
Factory device instance is on a label (68002-68100 when ordered in a panel, DEV68000 default); change it through AV 1003.
The manual recommends consecutive MAC addresses, Max Master set to the real device count and Max Info Frames 1.
gotchas: Panel inputs control relays at priority 16; a BMS write at a higher priority overrides the wall switches.
A manual override at the panel sets the BO Override status flag; clear it with the RESET button.
COV subscriptions expire by default; write 1 to AV 100 to allow lifetime 0.

note: Provided as-is. Point availability varies by firmware and options; verify against the live device.
